assertions.assertion: Protected reference-only GetDiagnostics sends a provider upload directory as location with the caller's startTime, stopTime, retries and retryInterval; a reply with fileName is acceptance only and a reply without fileName means no diagnostics are available.

Every DiagnosticsStatusNotification is committed before its empty reply and advances the newest unresolved GetDiagnostics job; Idle is a triggered not-busy report that resolves the job without claiming success.

Protected reference-only GetLog sends DiagnosticsLog or SecurityLog with the caller's requestId and time window and a provider remoteLocation; Accepted, Rejected and AcceptedCanceled replies and the optional filename are preserved exactly.

LogStatusNotification advances only the job with its exact requestId; a missing requestId is accepted only for Idle; Uploading, Uploaded and the four failure statuses decode, and regressions or late reports are counted, not applied.

AcceptedCanceled cancels the previous unresolved log job; later reports for a cancelled job never revive it. UploadLogStatusEnumType has no AcceptedCanceled value, so the N01.FR.20 notification is refused as schema-invalid.

The station uploads a single file to the provider destination by PUT or POST with its reported file name appended to the trailing-slash location; a reported Uploaded is confirmed against the size and SHA-256 of the bytes the provider actually stored.
Lost replies stay uncertain and are never replayed after restart or reconnect; a deadline only times the job out; later native reports still resolve the job, and only resolved jobs release the drain.

not_covered: SecurityEventNotification and the security-log contents themselves (N01.FR.05, issue #127)
FTP/FTPS uploads, upload resume and Expect: 100-continue (N01.FR.14, N01.FR.22, N01.FR.23)
